reasons: The Datadog metric nginx.net.conn_dropped_per_s has no direct OTel equivalent in the provided definitions; the candidate computes it as accepted minus handled, which the rules require to be blocked with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING and the derived expression placed in notes.
The candidate mixes aggregations: avg() over the accepted rate and sum() over the handled rate, so the difference is not a well-defined per-series quantity.

The Datadog template variable $Host (prefix host) is silently dropped, but the OTel metrics have no attributes and no host label is observed, so the host filter cannot be represented and the series set differs.
Outcome should be blocked (MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING), not translated.
